title: Time Series Stock Price Forecasting Based on Genetic Algorithm (GA)-Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) Optimization
data_requirements: data from 2016-2021 was selected as the training set and the data from 2021-2022 was selected as the test set
training_protocol: Epoch was set to 100 and run using Python 3.10. LSTM model is first initialized or tuned using genetic algorithm to find a better initial solution. Then, during the training process, the hyperparameters can be continuously tuned to optimize the LSTM network structure according to the genetic algorithm, and the best individuals can be selected for updating in each iteration.
evaluation_protocol: model was evaluated using MSE, MAE and MAPE

reported_results.raw: MAE on the test set is 2.41, the MSE is 9.84, the RMSE is 3.13, and the R2 is 0.87. MAE of the model gradually decreases from 0.11 to 0.01.
